text.ru: Один луч — и в нём уже все цвета.

art: Iris, a poised duelist-painter, raises a faceted glass prism; a beam of white light enters and arcs out of it as a rainbow fan sweeping across her, her brush trailing refracted color

text.ru: Я пишу не светом, а его отсутствием.

art: Erebus, half-swallowed in shadow, haloed by the bright corona of a total eclipse; darkness drips from his brush as he paints with the absence of light

text.ru: Смешай два света — и родится третий.

art: Tiziana, a painter holding up a large round glowing artist's palette laden with light-paints in one hand, sweeping a broad brush across it with the other as two colours stream together and bloom into a third where they meet

text.ru: Я бужу свет огранённым.

art: Gemma holds a many-faceted crystal up to the light and strikes a clean facet, splitting a thin beam into sharp geometric glints

text.ru: Летит на чужой огонь и приносит свой.

art: a moth in sharp close-up with smouldering cinder-dusted wings trailing sparks, darting low beneath raised shields straight at its mark

text.ru: Один плевок — и цель уже тлеет.

art: an archerfish of red ray-light spitting a hard jet of sparks at a distant mark, the spark-jet the brightest line in the frame

text.ru: Даже погаснув, успевает лизнуть напоследок.

art: a wingless drake hatchling of cooling ash in sharp close-up, small against the dark, jaws parting for one last scorching breath

text.ru: Тонок, да пробивает насквозь.

art: a large gnat with a long needle-lance for a proboscis, lowered like a couched spear to run its target clean through

text.ru: Чем больше пьёт, тем дольше тлеет.

art: a swollen tick latched onto its prey, its body glowing hotter and fuller the more it drinks

text.ru: Один укол — и щит уже ни при чём.

art: a hornet with an oversized barbed stinger shedding a trail of embers, driving it clean through a raised shield into the space beyond

text.ru: Проносится сквозь строй, будто того и нет.

art: a galloping horse-shaped beast with a solid clearly drawn body, its mane and tail streaming off as ash and embers, streaking past a braced wall of shields

text.ru: Пляшет — и раны хозяина затягивает жаром.

art: a long-legged ember-crane in a whirling fire-dance, wings fanned and neck arched, threads of warm light spiralling off-frame

text.ru: Рвёт — и чужой кровью гасит собственные раны.

art: a lean tuft-eared lynx mid-pounce with claws bared, its own gashes searing shut in the heat as it strikes

text.ru: Небо занялось — и каждый клинок стал злее.

art: a low blood-red sunrise cresting over a scorched empty plain, long knife-sharp rays raking forward across the ground

text.ru: Плюнуть жаром — недолго и недалеко, но метко.

art: a compact gout of fire spat hard and flat across the frame, tight and aimed, sparks peeling off its tail

text.ru: Панцирь набит жаром, и он не любит терпеть.

art: a fat armored bombardier beetle, its cracked venting shell packed with heat, jets of hot light hissing from the cracks, an instant from bursting apart

text.ru: Заряжает кристаллом, стреляет искрами.

art: a heavy armoured armadillo of red ray-light, a spark-launching vent grown into its back-plates, a single bright spark flaring from it

text.ru: Что клинок отнимает, то жар возвращает хозяину.

art: a heavy branded ram standing guard at a narrow pass, searing glyph-brands glowing along its flanks, warm light streaming back off-frame with every goring blow it lands

text.ru: Пока горит — вокруг всё точит когти жарче.

art: a squat coral-like polyp burning like a small bonfire, flames dancing along its crown of arms, a shimmering heat-haze sharpening everything near it

text.ru: Ритм гонит вперёд и не даёт остыть.

art: a ring of great war-drums of red ray-light, their struck skins rippling, concentric shockwaves of heat rolling out with every beat

text.ru: Он не целит в строй — он целит выше.

art: a towering column of fire plunging from a smoke-dark sky onto one distant point on an empty plain, the ground between left untouched

text.ru: Толстостенна и терпелива — бьёт весь бой.

art: a heavy siege-turtle with an ember-cannon fused to its thick shell, belching a bright spark downrange

text.ru: Летит долго, а падает точно в лоб.

art: a red-hot comet with a long ember tail plunging out of a dark sky toward a far ridge of dark ground

text.ru: Идёт напрямик, и даже смерть его обжигает.

art: a towering titan of molten stone, its huge horned head and massive arms clearly drawn, striding straight through a crumbling shield-wall, heat bleeding from its cracked hide

text.ru: Смотришь сквозь — и не понимаешь, где стена.

art: a broad shimmering wall of golden heat-haze rippling across the lane, the air behind it warping and doubling, rising to swallow the first blow

text.ru: Успевает сверкнуть первым.

art: a glass-winged sunbird in sharp close-up riding a needle-sharp glint of golden light, striking first before it is even seen

text.ru: Стоит на своём и не сходит.

art: a tall standing waymark stone crowned with golden light on an open road, immovable, holding the path against all who would pass

text.ru: Возьмёт чужую беду на себя.

art: a ward-spirit shaped like a hanging sun-charm in sharp close-up, drinking a hostile curse-bolt out of the air and pulling blows onto itself

text.ru: Кто идёт на него — тот падает первым.

art: a great upright sword of dawn-gold light standing on guard, cutting down each attacker that closes before it can land a blow

text.ru: На два удара света не станет.

art: a dark moon biting into the blazing sun, a long cone of shadow sweeping across the plain below

text.ru: Полдень замирает, и раны стихают.

art: a hushed golden meadow at the day's still point, warm light pooling low over the calm grass, every stem stilled

text.ru: Каждый глоток света возвращается врагу жаром.

art: a haloed serpent coiled in an open spiral, a burning crown of rays at its brow, flinging a hot lance outward

text.ru: Полыхнёт — и противник слепнет на подходе.

art: a great hawk of heat-lightning in a diving strike, its outspread wings branching into forks of silent lightning, flooding the pass below with blinding light

text.ru: Что о него разбивается, то лечит хозяина.

art: a towering pillar of solid golden light rooted to the field, each blow that breaks against it sending warmth streaming back off-frame

text.ru: Свет, процеженный сквозь цвет, чинит павших.

art: a great stained-glass rose window ablaze at midday, its warmest beam finding and knitting the deepest crack in the mosaic floor below

text.ru: На белое солнце не смотрят дважды.

art: one colossal graphic sunburst, its core burned to pure searing white, a full crown of hard straight rays radiating to every edge of the frame, the thin strip of plain below bleached bone-white

text.ru: За ним и герой становится стеной.

art: a long crenellated rampart wall of dawn-gold light standing across the field, the hero sheltering behind it sheathed in fresh golden armor

text.ru: Гаснет — и напоследок слепит убийц.

art: a great lantern-moth in sharp close-up, its wings a guttering halo of golden light collapsing into one last brilliant flash

text.ru: Изматывает жарой, а сам всё крепче.

art: a massive heat-shimmer aurochs standing its ground, golden haze pooling deep around its legs, the air above its back warping harder as the day burns hotter

text.ru: Разит первым, а удары по нему греют хозяина.

art: a scarab beetle sheathed in faceted heliodor-gem plates, its edged shell flashing to strike first, each blow that breaks on it streaming back off-frame as warmth

text.ru: В высшей точке бьёт дважды и не гаснет.

art: a blazing phoenix at the peak of its climb, lashing twice with wings of noon-fire and mending itself as it hangs aloft

text.ru: Всякий целебный луч он оборачивает клинком.

art: a great sun-dragon biting its own tail into a closed slow-turning wheel, hard ray-spokes sweeping the field as it rolls

text.ru: Рык — и свет бьёт дважды.

art: a colossal radiant lion-titan maned in noon-fire in a heroic chest-up portrait, its mane blazing to the frame's edge, roaring toward a far horizon

text.ru: Свет уходит весь — и возвращается только к тебе.

art: a black sun ringed by a thin burning corona hanging low over a dark plain, a river of gold light draining down toward the near edge of the frame

text.ru: Первый цветок дня — и первый лишний кристалл.

art: a primrose bud in sharp close-up unfurling at dawn, drawing a single crystal out of the first light

text.ru: Забьёт из земли — и щедро.

art: a spring of liquid light welling up through cracked earth, two crystals rising and turning in the bright upflow

text.ru: Роет вглубь и выносит свет наружу.

art: a burrowing mole with broad crystal-tipped claws, surfacing from the soil clutching a freshly unearthed shard

text.ru: Горсть за горстью — и поле полно всходов.

art: a lone sower striding across a furrowed field, casting a wide sweeping arc of glowing seed from a shoulder-bag, green sprouts rising in neat rows in the turned earth behind, the figure drawn as flat glowing green light-lines, not a realistic painted person

text.ru: Обовьёт и стравит — сам в стороне.

art: a mass of grasping vines lashing out of the undergrowth and cinching tight into one great strangling knot

text.ru: Дай ему волю — и он перерастёт всё.

art: a single sapling erupting in one surge into a towering crown of leaves

text.ru: Лопнет — и на его месте двое.

art: a fat armoured weevil with a long down-curved snout, two swollen spore-sacs on its back straining to burst into fresh sprouts

text.ru: С каждым днём гуще и злее.

art: a sheer fortress wall built entirely of woven thorn-branches, bristling with long spikes, thickening taller and meaner season by season

text.ru: Чем гуще подлесок, тем злее рой.

art: a seething swarm of small crawlers each armoured in long jutting bramble-thorns, knotting together into one rolling ball of spikes, fiercer the denser the thicket around them

text.ru: Под его сенью раны заживают сами.

art: a broad ancient oak with a spreading crown, a soft steady fall of leaf-litter mending the wounded sheltering beneath it

text.ru: Что ни утро — то полная горсть.

art: a heavy fruit-laden tree, two ripe crystalline fruits dropping from its boughs at first light each dawn

text.ru: Растёт быстрее, чем его успевают срубить.

art: a towering treant standing watch at the edge of a young grove, its trunk and roots swelling broader and taller by the hour

text.ru: Срежь его — и семя вернётся в ладонь.

art: a hardy perennial flower on a tall stem; cut down, it casts a single seed that drifts off to sprout anew

text.ru: Кормится всем, что умирает вокруг.

art: a heaving mound of loamy soil and tangled roots hunching upright, swelling bigger with every creature that dies nearby

text.ru: Лес встаёт весь и разом.

art: a whole grove of trees tearing their roots loose from the soil and heaving upright together

text.ru: Размером со всё, что ты успел скопить.

art: a giant sloth of living heartwood curled up asleep, its slow body grown around a glowing pulsing heart-core, swelling larger the more crystals lie hoarded around it

text.ru: Целый подлесок, сросшийся в одно.

art: a hulking bear-shaped colossus woven of vine and knotted root, rearing upright, bulkier the fuller the field around it grows

text.ru: Столетия роста в одном шаге.

art: a colossal mammoth sculpted from ancient moss and knotted roots, growing more massive and towering with every ponderous step

text.ru: Корень, из которого поднялся весь лес.

art: a world-spanning root heaving up out of the earth, its tangled root-limbs clearly drawn, its young canopy still climbing toward the sky

text.ru: Черпай — не вычерпаешь.

art: a deep stone well brimming with liquid sunlight, three crystals welling up and spilling over its sun-bright rim

text.ru: Смотрит на шаг вперёд остальных.

art: a crystalline drake in sharp close-up peering through a clear lens of ice, a faint vision of what comes next surfacing in its eye

text.ru: Встал на пост — и всё вокруг застыло.

art: a tall heron of blue ice-light standing sentinel, freezing mist pooling around its legs, its breath blooming into hoarfrost over the rimed reeds

text.ru: Встала — и не сдвинуть.

art: a towering glacier wall of clear blue ice spanning the whole field, immovable, shapes of things yet to come frozen dimly visible deep within it

text.ru: Придёт волна — и унесёт лишнее обратно.

art: a sleek half-translucent seal-spirit of pale blue light, its long whiskers and finned tail clearly drawn, curling back off the shore, the tide drawn out after it, flotsam dragged in its wake

text.ru: Каждое заклинание точит его грани.

art: a faceted crystal dragonfly hovering in place, gazing unblinking as if reading what comes next in the light, every wing-edge honed keener each time a stray bolt crackles past

text.ru: Один луч входит — два выходят.

art: a gliding crystalline manta ray, a single beam entering its clear body and leaving as two diverging rays

text.ru: Копит свет заклинаний и бьёт им.

art: a slowly drifting cut-glass jellyfish, its faceted bell hoarding each passing bolt of light as an ever-brightening inner glare

text.ru: Дышит — и рядом всё покрывается инеем.

art: a walrus-shaped colossus of ancient glacial ice seen from a low angle, colossal tusks of clear ice, hoarfrost shaggy on its bull neck, its frozen breath sheathing the ground before it in rime

text.ru: Всплывёт из глубины — и море встанет льдом.

art: a whale-like deep-sea leviathan breaching, its barnacled head and jaws towering over the water, the sea freezing solid in rings around its body

text.ru: Схватит за горло холодом.

art: a huge clawed hand of jagged frost clamping shut around empty air, hoarfrost spraying from between its closing talons

text.ru: Утянет чужого — или спасёт своего.

art: a violent spiralling current twisting down beneath a calm sea surface, dragging weed and driftwood under in its funnel

text.ru: Видит дальше — берёт лучшее.

art: a still scrying-pool mirroring several far-off visions, one of them rising up out of the water as a pane of light

text.ru: Луч, что не гасят ни щит, ни нимб.

art: a needle-thin lance of light striking a floating round shield and splintering on impact into a fan of shard-rays

text.ru: Тянется медленно — а укроет всех.

art: root-like fingers of frost creeping in from one edge of dark ground, branching as they crawl toward the far side

text.ru: Разом и надолго.

art: a whole stretch of ground and air sealed inside one solid block of ancient clear ice, frozen mid-motion for an age

text.ru: Течёт под льдом — и не иссякает.

art: a swift meltwater stream running beneath a lid of ice, a spreading fan of glowing light-panes carried up in its current

text.ru: Ляжет весь строй — и надолго.

art: upright hollow sarcophagi of clear ice standing in silent rows on dark ground, a long winter sealed inside them

text.ru: Мороз кусает — и рука слабеет.

art: a radial burst of hoarfrost snapping outward from a single point in one instant, icicle spikes frozen mid-leap

text.ru: Сквозь дымку и заклинание идёт с трудом.

art: a hanging curtain of pale freezing mist drawn across the field, the air behind it thick and still

text.ru: Всё двоится — и удар тоже.

art: a shimmering doubled after-image lying over the whole field, every shape softly split into two overlapping copies

text.ru: Пока не вспыхнет — его не видно.

art: a firefly hovering on open blurred wings in deep darkness, its abdomen a soft lantern of violet light dimmed down to a faint ember, a thin trail of fading glow behind it

text.ru: Явь ли, тень ли — поди разбери, которая.

art: three overlapping images of one hooded violet wraith with a gaunt face and trailing sleeves, caught half-dissolved between solid form and empty air, each copy fainter than the last

text.ru: Ты его заметишь, когда уже поздно.

art: a powerful violet panther prowling low and taut in sharp close-up, muscles bold and clearly drawn, eyes fixed ahead, deep shadow pooling around its paws as it steals forward unseen

text.ru: В его тени легко спрятать первый шаг.

art: a broad-winged violet moth at dusk, its wide shadow spilling across the ground to hide whatever slips beneath it

text.ru: Свет уходит — и с ним сила.

art: a creeping violet dusk sweeping across the ground, every glow it passes over guttering down to a faint ember

text.ru: Шагни в марево — и пропади для чужих глаз.

art: a rippling violet heat-mirage rising like a curtain, the space behind it dissolving into a wavering blur

text.ru: Их двое — а бьёт настоящий.

art: two identical violet shadow-figures standing side by side in mirror poses, one solid and one a hollow echo, impossible to tell apart

text.ru: Светит так, что вокруг только тени.

art: an anglerfish-shade of deep violet shadow, a small glowing lantern hanging from the lure-stalk arched over its head, the lantern the brightest point in the frame, its glimmer deepening the dark around into a hiding pool of shadow

text.ru: Повтори слух — и вот их уже двое.

art: a violet echo-ripple spreading from a point in the dark, splitting into two identical rings drifting apart

text.ru: Спрятан в рукаве до самого удара.

art: a violet mantis of shadow-light, its long blade-limbs folded flat and hidden against its body, edges melting into the dark until the strike

text.ru: Убьёшь — а он приснится снова.

art: a great violet nightjar gliding silent through the dark, a fainter after-image trailing a wingbeat behind it

text.ru: Ложный свет — но бьёт по-настоящему.

art: a false violet dawn flaring low along the horizon, the gloom above it surging brighter for one fleeting moment

text.ru: Не рой, а морок роя — но с когтями.

art: a violet haze breaking apart into a swarm of three small flickering illusory clawed shapes

text.ru: Одного мало — их всегда чуть больше.

art: two overlapping violet shadow-hares mid-bound, the front one solid, the other its exact ghostly double trailing the same leap a beat late

text.ru: Целься в него — попадёшь в другого.

art: a hooded sentry of wavering violet shadow posted on guard, its outline rippling like heat-haze and melting from one form into another, an incoming beam bending aside off its shifting edge, drawn as flat glowing violet light-lines, not a realistic painted person

text.ru: Не убить — просто отменить.

art: a hollow beast-shape of pale light unravelling thread by thread into drifting violet strands, blowing apart into nothing

text.ru: Под его знаменем встают даже тени.

art: a bannerman holding high a tattered banner of pure shadow, ranks of phantom soldiers mustering ever thicker beneath it, drawn as flat glowing violet light-lines, not a realistic painted person

text.ru: Правит войском, которого нет.

art: a vast crowned violet shadow-cuttlefish throned above a host of hollow phantom copies, hostile light sliding off its mantle

text.ru: Дремлет среди кристаллов — пока не проснётся.

art: a huge violet shadow-crocodile lying deathly still among banked crystals, one heavy eye just cracking open

text.ru: Схорони его загодя — вернётся в свой час.

art: a towering violet shadow-cicada clawing up from a cache of buried crystals, hostile light sliding off its carapace

text.ru: Лопнет искрой — и достанет до лица.

art: a hunched hard-shelled flea insect with oversized springing hind legs, caught mid-leap high against the dark, a chain of small sparks crackling along its jump arc

text.ru: Сгниёт — и на его месте новый.

art: a cluster of slender honey-fungus mushrooms sagging rotten on an old stump, their caps sloughing away into a soft drift of spores

text.ru: Летит в лицо и там сгорает.

art: a ragged fly insect with big red compound eyes and tattered soot-black wings, a thin smear of soot trailing behind it, its inner glow guttering out in a puff of soot against its mark

text.ru: Кормит собой два новых ростка.

art: a scarab beetle braced low on the ground behind a carrion ball twice its size, shoving the ball forward along the earth, ridged wing-cases clearly drawn, two fresh sprouts rising from the ball's crust

text.ru: Тянет из света лишний кристалл.

art: a resinous sapling shoot unfurling toward the light, a crystal beading like sap at its tip

text.ru: Из-под савана уже пробилась зелень.

art: a moss-wrapped corpse-husk with a green sprout forcing up between its ribs

text.ru: Один сноп в жертву — и полные руки взамен.

art: a bound sheaf of green light-stalks collapsing and scattering apart in a bright fall, two glowing panes of green light rising up out of the spilling grain

text.ru: Что вас лечит, то врага жжёт.

art: a kneeling novice in rough robes cupping a blood-red pitcher-bloom, the bloom spitting a searing thorn whenever warm healing light washes over it, drawn as flat glowing red and green light-lines, not a realistic painted person

text.ru: Пьёт кровь и жиреет на падали.

art: a tangled thorn-bramble beast lapping blood with red barbed thorns while its green creepers fatten on the corpses rotting around it

text.ru: Рвёт — и жаром латает хозяина.

art: a lean wolf with coal-glowing eyes mid-lunge, warm light flowing back to seal its master's wounds

text.ru: Пасёт грибное стадо.

art: a robed shepherd with a tall crook herding a trotting flock of small round mushrooms down a woodland path, drawn as flat glowing green light-lines, not a realistic painted person

text.ru: Раздулся падалью — и лопнет на три всхода.

art: a huge bloated puffball mushroom straining at its skin, three fat spore-sacs bulging and about to burst free

text.ru: Что скосит своё — тем и растёт.

art: a gaunt robed reaper swinging a long scythe through a half-mown field of glowing stalks, the cut swathe withering behind it, drawn as flat glowing red and green light-lines, not a realistic painted person

text.ru: Прилив крови бьёт в чужой берег.

art: a breaking tide of crimson blood and green sap surging up a dark shore, a searing lance of light bursting forward out of each cresting wave

text.ru: Жрёт мертвечину и пухнет.

art: a fat glistening slug gorging on carrion, its bloated body visibly swelling larger as it feeds on the fallen

text.ru: Каждой смерти — плата кровью.

art: a gaunt hooded mourner kneeling over grave-mounds, moss-green veils trailing from its shoulders, red weeping streaks down its cloak, flinging a burning blood-mote skyward for every fresh grave, drawn as flat glowing red and green light-lines, not a realistic painted person

text.ru: Всех на костёр — и пусть враг горит.

art: a funeral pyre of red flame and green kindling-boughs consuming a row of small guttering wisps, a wave of scorching heat rolling outward from it

text.ru: Ест прах и сеет прах.

art: a hulking tusked boar-scavenger of red embers and green fungal crust, rooting through ash and swelling on the dead, bursting a spore when slain

text.ru: Каждое заклинание — новая искра в брюшке.

art: a firefly hovering on open blurred wings, its abdomen a bright lantern of red light flaring hotter each time a stray bolt crackles past, a thin trail of sparks behind it

text.ru: Ловит разряды и точит клешни.

art: a mantis with raised blade-arms, arcs of sparking current leaping between its scythes as magic passes

text.ru: Молнией мимо строя — прямо в лицо.

art: a darting swift crackling with lightning, embers streaming off its left wing and frost trailing from its right, slipping low past a braced wall of shields

text.ru: Бьёт током всё сильнее с каждым словом.

art: an electric eel coiled to strike, sparks and creeping frost chasing along its body as its charge builds ever brighter

text.ru: Один рог — а лучей два.

art: a crystal unicorn rearing, its body split cleanly down the middle, the left half wreathed in blazing fire with a mane of flame, the right half sheathed in thick blue ice with a tail of icicles, its spiral horn glowing where both halves meet

text.ru: Смотрит в угли и видит ход вперёд.

art: a keen-eyed salamander crouched over live coals, frost misting off its spines, reading what comes next in the glowing embers

text.ru: Гроза слушается каждого его слова.

art: a towering tyrant-lizard with embers glowing in its throat and hoarfrost crusted along its spine, lightning gathering around its horns as the storm speaks around it

text.ru: Вьётся в тумане, что глушит чужие чары.

art: a long serpent winding through a muffling storm-fog, sparks flickering along its coils and hoarfrost trailing from its tail

text.ru: Короткая вспышка — прямо в лицо.

art: a single thin whip-crack of crimson flame arcing high across the dark and gone in an instant

text.ru: Разряд под дых.

art: a sharp colourless spark leaping a short gap between two dark stones, snapping hard at the point of impact

text.ru: Тонкий разряд — сквозь щит и нимб.

art: a needle-thin bolt, half searing fire and half biting frost, punching clean through a floating shield and a ring of light beyond it

text.ru: По морозу — и трещина до дна.

art: a fracture line racing across a block of solid ice until it bursts apart into glittering shards

text.ru: Свои — ярче, чужие — тусклее.

art: a dark plain split clean in two, one half flaring with ember-heat, the other locked under creeping frost, the borderline razor-sharp

text.ru: Чем больше искр за ход, тем громче удар.

art: a churning red-and-blue storm-anvil built entirely of glowing ray-light, lit brightly from within, discharging a single massive forked bolt down at a distant point

text.ru: Разлом жара под ногами врага.

art: a jagged molten rift tearing open across dark cracked ground, lava-light welling up out of the crack and washing the stones red

text.ru: Греется на свету — и копит его в кристалл.

art: a novice in a moss-grown hooded robe kneeling toward the light, a single crystal condensing in its cupped hands, drawn as flat glowing green light-lines, not a realistic painted person

text.ru: Тряхнёт щетиной — и всходы тут как тут.

art: a stocky warden of green light leaning on a gnarled staff over neat rows of fresh sprouts, seeds spilling from a pouch at its belt and sprouting where they fall, drawn as flat glowing green light-lines, not a realistic painted person

text.ru: Жиреет на всём, что гниёт рядом.

art: a broad-domed dung-beetle with flattened digging forelegs burrowing through dark humus, its thick shell heavier the more everything rots around it

text.ru: Убьёшь — вернётся тенью.

art: a pale hooded phantom with a gaunt face and long trailing sleeves rising anew above its own crumpled husk fading on the ground, thinner and paler than before

text.ru: Их сразу трое — поди пойми, который.

art: three overlapping duplicates of one crude carved idol-totem of violet shadow-stone, splitting apart and mirroring each other's sway

text.ru: Каждое утро — двойная жатва света.

art: a hulking marsh-beast with a broad plough-shaped bone snout, churning deep straight furrows through the soggy fen, bright crystals welling up from the turned muck behind it

text.ru: Оплетает могилы и тянет мёртвых назад.

art: a coiling serpent-like mass of green-and-violet ivy winding over a low grave-barrow of stones, pale grave-blossoms opening along its glowing tendrils

text.ru: Один оленёнок — а следов вдвое.

art: two fawns crowned with moss-and-fern antlers in a chest-up portrait, one solid, the other its hollow violet echo overlapping a half-step behind

text.ru: Сколько скопишь, столько и поднимется.

art: a four-legged colossus hewn of green crystal rising to its feet, its blocky legs, broad shoulders and horned head clearly drawn, a violet phantom twin looming half-transparent behind it

text.ru: Один морок сеет целый рой.

art: two round-bodied wisp-orbs of tangled green vines wrapped in violet haze, the larger budding the smaller hollow copy straight out of its side

text.ru: Что скошено — вновь в ладонь.

art: two glowing seeds flung up out of a turned furrow, arcing high against the dark and falling back toward the near edge of the frame

text.ru: Дремлет в кристаллах — и растёт во сне.

art: a long crenellated rampart wall of mossy green stone-light lying dormant under a violet cloak of shadow, half-buried among banked crystals, its wall-tiers slowly rising even as it sleeps

text.ru: Среди бликов не разглядеть идущего.

art: a hanging violet veil of scattered glints, the shadow beneath it pooling deeper and darker than the night around

text.ru: Гряда чинит всё, что ещё дышит.

art: a steaming bed of rich mulch and rotting leaves, new green shoots knitting up out of every torn patch

text.ru: Растёт и вширь, и ввысь.

art: a shaggy plodding ox woven from living thorn-brambles, its bristling coat thickening taller and broader by the day

text.ru: Крадётся в сумерках мимо любых стен.

art: a lithe violet shadow-marten on the hunt, slinking unseen through the dusk, slipping past a standing wall into the gloom

text.ru: Бей — отзовётся только эхо.

art: a violet shadow-bat wheeling through the dark, an incoming beam bending off it toward a fainter echo of itself

text.ru: Прикрутит фитиль — и враг слепнет.

art: a lamplighter of dull golden light-lines filling the frame, reaching up with long tongs to pinch a small hanging lantern's flame down to its last dim ember, deep darkness pressing in all around, drawn as flat glowing yellow light-lines, not a realistic painted person

text.ru: Затаится в кристаллах, встанет незримой.

art: a long flat shadow spilled across the ground between banked glowing crystals, its lurking outline hinting a crouched prowling beast, two narrow glowing eyes opening inside the darkness of it

text.ru: Свет манит удары на себя.

art: a night watchman of golden light-lines making the rounds, holding up a bright lantern on a staff, blows arcing out of the dark toward the lantern-light and breaking against its raised shield, drawn as flat glowing yellow light-lines, not a realistic painted person

text.ru: Двое дразнят, бьют по обоим.

art: two violet shadow-peacocks fanned side by side, one solid and one a hollow mirror-copy, both spreading their tails wide to draw every gaze

text.ru: Заслонка держит и чинит сама себя.

art: a tall shutter of interlocking golden light-slats sliding shut across the lane, its cracked slats knitting whole again

text.ru: Входит — и гасит первого попавшегося.

art: a hulking gaoler-hound of golden light looming chest-up over a barred cage of light, its first hard glare snuffing the captive glow inside

text.ru: Молча глотает первое проклятье за союзника.

art: a squat sentinel-toad planted square in the lane, silently gulping a hostile curse-bolt down its throat and drawing blows onto itself

text.ru: Высветит всё, что враг прячет в запасе.

art: a great watch-owl perched atop a blazing beacon-pyre, its searchlight gaze sweeping the dark and laying every hidden thing bare

text.ru: Зарыт среди кристаллов — до первого удара.

art: a violet scorpion-shade half-buried among glowing violet crystals, only the bright bared tip of its long blade-tail glinting above the shards, poised to strike

text.ru: Разобьётся — и полыхнёт по глазам.

art: a dragonfly of brittle golden glass striking first, its wings bursting at the shatter-instant into a blinding golden flare

text.ru: Каждый ход гасит по одному.

art: a slow-pacing gaol-keeper basilisk, its stare snuffing one cell-light after another as it passes

text.ru: Держит фронт и чинится к утру.

art: a great antlered stag of dawn in a noble chest-up portrait, vast antlers filling the top of the frame, first light breaking behind its head, its wounds closing again by morning

text.ru: Ослеп — значит приговорён.

art: a great violet snuffer-bell of shadow descending over a small guttering flame, the last light choking out beneath its rim

text.ru: Бей его — попадёшь в соседа; убей — ослепнешь.

art: a broad violet shadow-crab planting itself as a living cage, attacks bending off its shell, bursting blinding-bright when it breaks

text.ru: Проснётся — и весь строй ослепнет.

art: a mountainous four-legged stone-shelled beast heaving awake from under banked crystals in violet dusk, loosing one blinding golden flash across the horizon

text.ru: Незрима — и бьёт дважды.

art: a hushed shrike of yellow glare half-dissolved into violet shadow, its sickle-hooked beak and wing-blades cutting its prey down twice, unseen

text.ru: Прядёт сумрак — по одному врагу за ночь.

art: a huge matriarch spider crouched in violet dusk-webs, her many eyes and silk glinting gold, drinking one stray light out of the dusk each night while hidden

text.ru: Река наносит — и щедро, и с толком.

art: a spread of river-silt fanning across a floodplain, a single crystal surfacing as the current sorts and reveals the path ahead

text.ru: Плавает и тянет свет со дна.

art: a broad lily pad afloat on still water, drawing a crystal up from the depths beneath it

text.ru: Скачет по илу, роняет ростки.

art: a mudskipper fish hopping across glistening silt, a young sprout springing up in its wake

text.ru: Разлив ушёл — а руки полны.

art: a rich fertile floodplain suddenly bursting into lush growth, two broad leaves unfurling and lifting free into the air

text.ru: Плотину прорвало — и всё пошло в рост.

art: a bursting levee loosing a muddy flood, three small sprouts riding the surge as the whole field lurches into growth

text.ru: Отлив уносит лишнее прочь.

art: a receding ebb-tide sliding back off a dark shore, dragging weed and driftwood off the sand with it

text.ru: Мелок, а холодом кусает.

art: a sleek minnow in sharp close-up darting across the frame, its wake glittering with frost, a far larger fish looming half-seen behind it rimed stiff and motionless

text.ru: Встал сам — и всё за ним встало.

art: a grinding jam of river ice-floes crushing together in a narrow channel, frozen solid at the moment of impact

text.ru: Ряска ширится, а лишнее сплавляет.

art: a living raft of matted green duckweed grown over drifting ice, thickening as the water crowds with growth, a cold swell heaving loose driftwood off its edge

text.ru: Копит камень — и дышит стужей.

art: a newt with moss-green flanks and a spine of quartz ice, swelling with every crystal hoarded beside it, breathing a rime of frost across the reeds

text.ru: Несёт ростки и студит берега.

art: a sleek river-otter with a solid clearly drawn body riding the rushing green-and-blue rapids, seeds scattering from its wake, hoarfrost trailing off its whiskers

text.ru: Тонкий лёд чинит своих и студит чужих.

art: a broad flat lichen-backed ray gliding low over the water, moss-beds mending in its green shadow, its frost-rimed wings numbing the surface it passes over

text.ru: Нырнёт — и унесёт добычу с собой.

art: a kingfisher with moss-green plumage and frost-rimed wings diving to snatch a gleaming catch clean out of the dark water, dawn light beading into a crystal on its back

text.ru: Разливается ростками и смывает чужое.

art: a huge brooding river-toad swollen with meltwater, spilling sprouting green seedlings from her mottled back while a cold surge sweeps the bank clear

text.ru: Растёт с рекой и студит на подходе.

art: a towering bull-shaped river-giant wading ashore chest-deep through the flood, moss and reeds matted across its massive shoulders, frost crackling out from every step

text.ru: Разольётся — и весь берег во льду.

art: a colossal whale-bodied leviathan rearing head and shoulders up out of the flood, green reeds streaming like a mane down its neck, its bellowing breath sheeting the water below with frost

text.ru: Тихо оплетает и дорастает до стены.

art: a dense creeping mass of green ray-light ivy, tendrils coiling and thickening upward to fill the frame, broadening hour by hour

text.ru: Ворота на замке — герой в броне.

art: a massive fortified barbican gatehouse of golden light barring the road, its raised gate layering fresh armor onto the hero sheltered within

text.ru: Стена, что сама дорастает до угрозы.

art: a long neat field-boundary hedge, level-trimmed and dense, a fresh thorny layer bristling up along its top

text.ru: Накинь покров — и удар, и проклятье мимо.

art: a mantle of golden light settling like a cloak over a rough standing stone, a shield-halo and a ward-halo kindling around it

text.ru: Ясный день — броня герою и покой раненым.

art: a bright golden noon over a green meadow, sunbeams hardening into hovering plates of golden armor while drifting leaves knit torn grass whole

text.ru: Растёт — и с каждым кольцом хозяину теплее.

art: a young oak putting on a fresh bright growth-ring, warm light streaming back from its boughs to its keeper

text.ru: Сад роняет по два кристалла в утро.

art: a tended garden plot where crystals bloom on stalks like flowers, two fresh shards ripening and hardening each dawn

text.ru: Стягивает удары и глотает первое проклятье.

art: a broad angular ravelin bastion of golden light jutting forward in a hard wedge, incoming blows sliding off its sloped faces while a halo swallows the first curse-bolt

text.ru: И в смерти вспыхнет врагу в глаза.

art: a high rampart wall built of glittering mica-plated golden light holding the lane, its flaking scales flaring blinding-white as it finally cracks apart

text.ru: Год от года гуще — и уже не выкорчевать.

art: a broad hawthorn shrub bristling with long thorns, swelling denser and larger year by year into an unkillable thicket

text.ru: Растущий бастион под бронёй.

art: a vast arching vault of golden-and-green light curving overhead like a domed firmament, hardening plate by plate into a towering wall

text.ru: Чем гуще лес за ним, тем шире рога.

art: a towering elk whose antlers branch into a whole oak grove of green boughs and golden leaves, the woodland crowding thick around its legs as it bars the road

text.ru: Чинится и растёт быстрее, чем его бьют.

art: a gnarled old elm-treant rooted across the road, its split bark knitting shut under a sheath of golden light while fresh green shoots bud faster than axes can bite

text.ru: Держит небо — и дважды роняет его на врага.

art: a colossal oak-titan straining to hold up the sky on its golden boughs, its green-barked trunk braced as two massive limb-arms hammer down twice

text.ru: Башня, что сама идёт на приступ — и бьёт дважды.

art: a towering keep-shaped guardian of interlaced golden roots and green bramble rising from a dense thicket, barring the way and slamming down twice with root-fists
